title: grapheneGate — The Hybrid Bone
thesis: grapheneGate IS the hybrid bone of the organism. Every other node has 1-2 connection types. The Pixel has ALL SEVEN. It doesn't just connect things — it IS the connection. The bone that holds the skeleton together.

usb.mode: adb (current) | tethering (self-NIC) | HID gadget (kernel supports, needs root)
usb.note: USB tethering creates usb0/ncm0 on host — the phone becomes a network interface

uwb.status: No sysfs entries (may need app to activate)
uwb.future: UWB ranging to other UWB devices = precise spatial tracking

cellular.potential: With SIM → independent internet, SMS, phone. The organism reaches beyond WiFi.

gps.role: Global positioning — knows where on Earth the bone is

self_nic_modes.usb_tethering: Plug USB → host gets usb0/ncm0 interface → internet via Pixel's WiFi/cellular
self_nic_modes.wifi_hotspot: Pixel broadcasts SSID → other devices join → internet via Pixel
self_nic_modes.bluetooth_pan: Bluetooth tethering → slower but works without WiFi/USB
self_nic_modes.adb_reverse: adb reverse → tunnel ports from Pixel to host

hybrid_bone_pattern.when_at_northgate: USB nerve + WiFi nerve → northGate gets NIC + eyes + ears + GPS + sensors
hybrid_bone_pattern.when_at_eastgate: USB nerve + WiFi nerve → eastGate gets NIC + eyes + ears + GPS + sensors
hybrid_bone_pattern.when_walking: WiFi only → fog layer bridge between houses, RSSI triangulation active
hybrid_bone_pattern.when_in_pocket: All sensors still active → heartbeat, motion, location, environment
hybrid_bone_pattern.always: WiFi mesh member → always reachable → always part of the organism

valve_wifi_adapter.note: Pure radio — one frequency band, no intelligence

grapheneGate.note: A self-NIC that can THINK about what it connects

the_bone: In anatomy, bones aren't passive — they make blood (marrow), store minerals, sense pressure, and hold everything together. grapheneGate is that bone: it makes connections (7 radios), stores data (256GB), senses everything (37 sensors), and holds the skeleton together by being the one thing that goes everywhere Kevin goes.
